card.name: Linking words inside section titles
card.fires_on: Small linking words like 'of' and 'for' right after a heading noun in a cross-reference or section title, such as 'Information for Patients' or 'Insertion of NEXPLANON'. Also a closing parenthesis after a publication year.

modes.label: Section title links
modes.description: 'of' or 'for' after a heading noun inside a cross-reference to a label section.

modes.label: Book and title text
modes.description: Closing bracket after a publication year or a word piece inside a book or chapter title.
